Lengths in beats of the song (112 BPM: 16.07 frames a beat at 30 fps; every cut lands on the nearest frame of a beat). glyph: the brush character of a chapter card (simplified Chinese: the brush font has no traditional forms). pictures / short: a name is a scene of one picture, a list of names a scene of several pictures of one feature (cards coming to the front in turn).

music.$comment: Song beats counted from firstBeat (seconds; a downbeat of a phrase, found by onset analysis). sections: [start, end) beats. A video plays intro, then its body sections (cut to fit: each drop starts on a chapter card), then outro.
